summary: Admit bounded 5Post C2C tariff preview through the reviewed runtime.

impacts.evidence: The existing authenticated rate route resolves the tenant-scoped logistics account before invoking the runtime.
Only bounded addresses, dimensions, point references and optional money are sent to the fixed provider endpoint; raw response data stays in transport.
OpenAPI and the neutral rate request gain additive optional provider-point and money fields.
No event envelope, event type or event payload changes.
The fivepost Transport gains the existing rate-reader operation and its adapter validates the new optional request fields.
The bounded preview uses the existing account and secret boundaries without new persisted state.
Fixed-host HTTPS, callback-scoped JWT exchange, bounded parcels, exact decimal money parsing and response-day limits are enforced.
The operation is read-only and reuses the existing connectors.read and account capability gates.
No new durable business mutation or audit record is introduced.
The rate read is bounded and does not retry or project an ambiguous external write.
The host adds one fixed official HTTPS tariff route and no inbound callback.
Shared HTTP timeouts, response limits and normalized runtime errors cover the tariff request.
Removing the fivepost rate branch or support capability closes this preview without migration.
Deterministic tests verify UUIDs, milligram conversion, exact money normalization, date bounds and the official response contract.
